         m = a % m;
         a = t;
         t = y;
         y = x - q * y;
         x = t;

      return x;
   }
   public static long power(long x, long y) {

      x %= mod;

         if ((y & 1) == 1) { res = (res * x) % mod; }
         y >>= 1;
         x = (x * x) % mod;
      }
      return res;
   }
